name: EnchantmentDefinition - Default (seed v1)
description: An enchantment items can carry: a vanilla Minecraft enchantment, or a custom Knights and Kings one with its own ability. Item blueprints list their default enchantments from these.

sections.description: What the enchantment is called and how strong it can get.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in the item's lore in game.

fields.label: Key
fields.description: Unique id: the Minecraft key for a vanilla enchantment (minecraft:sharpness), a short key for a custom one (armor_repair).

fields.label: Description
fields.description: What the enchantment does, in a sentence.

fields.label: Max level
fields.description: Highest level an item may hold. An item's grade can cap it lower.

fields.label: Custom
fields.description: On for Knights and Kings enchantments the plugin implements itself, off for vanilla ones.

sections.description: The Minecraft enchantment this one is based on. Empty for a fully custom enchantment.
Only for custom enchantments: the ability the plugin runs. Changed with Edit.

fields.label: Ability
fields.description: Which ability in the plugin this enchantment triggers.

fields.label: Ability settings
fields.description: Settings passed to the ability, as JSON.

sections.description: Item blueprints whose new copies get this enchantment. View or Edit opens the blueprint.

notes: Default on item blueprints: the read DTO lists ItemBlueprint summaries (ItemBlueprintNavDto, with the blueprint id), the model navigation is a list of ItemBlueprintDefaultEnchantment; relatedEntityTypeName is ItemBlueprint so View/Edit open the blueprint, hence metadataCheck "warn".
